findings.evidence: In template/scripts/lifecycle_workers.py, `gate_scratch = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(...)` is created before `work_next`, and `gate_scratch.cleanup()` runs only after the idle/refused check. If `work_next` raises, or the `WorkerError` for an idle result with refusals is raised first, cleanup is skipped. The directory then depends on garbage-collection finalization. A try/finally or a context manager would be safer.
findings.summary: The provider-gate scratch directory is only removed on the straight-line path, so exceptions leave it behind.

findings.evidence: design.md says "only a registered condition raises it". EnvironmentFailure.__init__ in lifecycle_workers.py accepts any string. The `environment_condition` decorator, `sandboxed_claude_writer` and pr_review_gate pass literals ("github-credential", "writer-runtime", "provider-credential"). A typo or an unregistered id would be released free of charge, which defeats the no-budget invariant. worker_preflight.CONDITION_IDS exists but is not checked at raise time.
findings.summary: The design says only a registered condition id may be carried by EnvironmentFailure, but nothing enforces it.
